title: Round 28 Atlantic state-frame USGS GNIS source register
scope: All-GNIS starter register for Georgia. Every seeded row reproduces one accepted USGS GNIS Geocoder candidate screened by exact official name, returned type/state/county, permanent FEATURE_ID, and returned primary point. Brasstown Bald and Lake Oconee additionally carry GNIS Domestic Names per-ID checks.

usgsGeocoder.use: Fuzzy candidate discovery only. A candidate was accepted only when Name, Type, State, County, GnisId, Latitude, and Longitude all matched the intended feature. County records, census divisions, consolidated-government records, canals, cuts, branches, bays, junctions, heights, parks, waterworks ponds, camp lakes, country-club lakes, historical arsenals, and same-name records of another county were rejected explicitly where relevant.

gnisDomesticNames.use: Per-ID identity checks for Brasstown Bald (354839), confirming the Georgia high-point description; and Lake Oconee (330982 seeded, parallel Oconee County record 319902 rejected), confirming the Rockville locator description. The public search/names/{featureId} route renders client-side, so the checks were executed against the official gaznames_default ArcGIS REST layer exposing gaz_featureclass, gaz_featuredescription, and gaz_elevation.

selectionRules: VERIFIED=1 is claimed only for an exact official name, compatible GNIS feature class/type, intended state and returned primary county, permanent FEATURE_ID, and an official point returned by a cited USGS service.

Grouped Geocoder Types map explicitly to stored row classes: Cities & Populated Places to Populated Place, Lakes & Reservoirs to Lake for the accepted named lakes, Streams & Canals to Stream for the accepted river records, and Summit to Summit.
A stored GNIS primary point is never described as a municipal boundary, street-address geocode, generic centroid, shoreline polygon, summit outline, or river centerline.

If exact-name candidates remain indistinguishable, the state-filtered screen returns no intended feature record, the returned record does not match the intended name and type, or the returned primary point does not identify an in-frame reach of the intended feature, the feature is omitted from that frame and the failure is disclosed; roster capacity holds are disclosed the same way.

Duplicate same-name reservoir records seed only the record whose official Domestic Names description independently locates the intended feature (Lake Oconee 330982 carries the Rockville locator; blank-description twin 319902 is disclosed, never merged).

Statewide frames use explicitly synthetic relief gaussians and generalized corridors; no bundled DEM or surveyed boundary is implied. Georgia ships a labelled generalized Atlantic coast line that is not a shoreline survey.

georgia.title: Georgia statewide frame
georgia.frameNote: Atlantic batch: the Atlanta, Savannah, Augusta, Columbus, Macon, and Athens anchors are balanced with per-ID Brasstown Bald (4784 feet), the Rockville-description Lake Oconee tie-break over the blank-description Oconee County twin, and the Ocmulgee, Oconee, and Altamaha river records. The county/census-division trap piles for all six cities, the Savannah River empty screen, the Lake Lanier populated-place-only mismatch, the Chattahoochee River starter-scope hold, and the Ocmulgee/Oconee confluence-point disclosure are recorded.

identityDecisions.decision: Seeded after a GNIS Domestic Names per-ID check against the gaznames_default REST layer showed gaz_featureclass Summit and the description Highest elevation in GA at 4784 feet at the stored point; the Geocoder returned a single exact Summit record in Towns County and the coordinate matches.
identityDecisions.notClaimed: The primary point is not a surveyed boundary of the high ground, and the quoted elevation is the record description, not a new survey.

identityDecisions.decision: Seeded over the parallel Oconee County same-name record (FEATURE_ID 319902): the per-ID check shows this record official description Located 6 km (3.7 mi) ENE of Rockville places it on the Putnam County shore of the intended Oconee River reservoir; the Oconee County record carries a blank description and a stored gaz_elevation of 221 against this record 132, so only the Rockville-identified record seeds.
identityDecisions.notClaimed: The primary point is not a shoreline or lake polygon, and the two records are disclosed rather than merged into one.

knownLimitations: Georgia is a starter register, not a statewide GNIS extract. It contains 12 deliberately selected identity-safe rows.

The USGS Geocoder is a suggestion service; exact-match screening by name/type/state/county/FEATURE_ID is part of the evidence, and the returned county is primary-county provenance. Brasstown Bald and Lake Oconee additionally carry per-ID Domestic Names detail checks executed against the official gaznames_default REST layer.

GNIS point data do not supply the displayed terrain or corridors. The frame uses explicitly synthetic relief gaussians and generalized context lines; the Atlantic coast line is generalized, not a shoreline survey.
State frames are rectangles, not state-boundary clipping masks. The Georgia rectangle includes small areas outside the state outline; no boundary geometry is claimed.
